coverage_notes.anvil-controller: The supplied verified and unverified corpus contains proof/spec functions, not executable contracts, and no actual input view() definitions. Three original proof targets are retained as explicit discovery exclusions, not determinism proofs.
coverage_notes.anvil-library: The supplied corpus has only two distinct executable contracts: VerusClone::verus_clone and vec_filter. The third selection is an original proof function, explicitly outside executable determinism coverage. View bounds on generic/Vec inputs are original, not invented.
coverage_notes.node-replication: The supplied verified and unverified corpus contains proof/spec functions only and no actual input view() definitions. Proof outputs must not be recast as executable functions merely to produce determinism results.
coverage_notes.atmosphere: ArraySet::new and Array::get were investigated but the current backend reports source-bound observation gaps for ArraySet<N> and &A. The final selections retain a real nongeneric virtual-address range constructor and accessor rather than modifying generic contracts to force them through.
coverage_notes.ironkv: StrictlyOrderedMap<K>::new was investigated but currently has a source-bound observation gap for generic map output. The final result case is the original EndPoint::clone_up_to_view, not a fabricated or specialized map contract.
